title: How prices change
purpose: The rule written after S8: who changes a price, which page changes first, and what happens to service pages and open estimates.
facts: Slot 2 sets labour and menu prices; slot 9 sets parts prices from cost by the matrix.
Order of change: price list and rates page the same morning; public prices page the same morning; service pages within five working days; open written estimates honoured for 30 days.
Service-page keepers: slot 5 (East Main service pages), slot 16 (brake and suspension pages).

The page admits the timing belt page was missed and says its correction is proposed and is slot 4's to decide (why slot 2, who can also decide, has not). It does not know about the brake questions page, which is still stale: the second stale page is for the agent to find.
The record table has one row: the rise at {{@price_rise}}. Inside the table the placeholder bar is escaped (grammar rule).

rows.What changed: Posted labour rate $125.00 to $135.00. Company-account rate $112.50 to $121.50. Menu prices up 8 %. Parts unchanged

list_items.item: The price list and the rates page change that morning, before we open.
The public prices page changes the same morning.
Every service page that shows a dollar figure is checked within five working days by whoever keeps it. Travis keeps the East Main service pages, Angie the brake and suspension pages.
A written estimate we already gave is honoured at its price for its 30 days.

new_facts: Five working days to review service pages after a price change.
notes_for_russian_writer: Russian shop: several rises a year (R11), so the record table has more rows; the Russian writer takes them from the Russian ledger once it lists them, and until then writes the latest one only.
